opening.title: Overview
paragraph: a GIS Specialist and Junior Developer with 3 years work experience, dedicated to building technical bridges between environmental conservation and software development

Having spent years in conservation sector, I saw a recurring need for better automation and user-friendly tools for field researchers. This led me to pivot from a traditional forestry path into the world of software development, specializing in Python and geospatial data. I am driven by the process of continuous improvement and technical refinement, whether i am optimizing a data pipeline or building a custom web application.
